summary.en:
- [[character:dhil]] is a CRIT DPS that excels at Blast as well as single-target fights. His Skill allows him to enhance his Basic ATK and extend his turn. The more Skill Points he consumes in a single turn (up to 3), the stronger his Basic ATK becomes, upgrading it from a weak Single Target attack into a powerful Blast attack.”
- His Ultimate gives him 2 stacks of "Squama Sacrosancta", acting like Skill Points for enhancing DHIL's Basic ATK, easing Skill Point consumption.
- [[character:dhil]]'s performance heavily relies on Sparkle. Getting Sparkle is recommended before going for [[character:dhil]]'s own vertical investments.

details.en:
- E2 provides a big increase in overall damage when compared to E0. It advances him forward by 100% after using his Ultimate.
- E1 is only a stepping stone to E2.
- S1 [[light-cone:brighter-than-the-sun]] enables a 3-turn Ultimate rotation, but is not a large damage increase.
